_how: The HUD news line (assets/ticker.js). headlines: short news lines (at most about 60 characters, no technical detail) about what is new on the testnet and the site, newest and most important first; a headline with until (an ISO time in UTC) leaves the line at that time; mark ghost puts the chain core's ghost symbol in front; picks: our X posts worth reposting, {text, href} with href the post's x.com address; invites: Telegram and X. New features also come in by themselves from the "major" entries of assets/updates.json. move: per language, left (text enters on the right, the usual way) or right. Every text needs its zh and ja translation in assets/i18n/zh/hud.js and ja/hud.js, or it is left out on those pages.
